title: Zubat's Sonar Isn't the Same in Every Colony

direction.premise: Zubat colonies can have slightly different ultrasonic frequencies, giving each group its own sonar variation.
direction.audiencePromise: Reveal how Zubat navigates without eyes, then show the slight frequency difference between colonies.
direction.openLoop: If Zubat navigates by sound, why can colonies use slightly different frequencies?
direction.payoff: Zubat shares eyeless ultrasonic sonar across colonies, while its frequencies can differ slightly from group to group.
direction.engagementQuestion: Which is cooler: eyeless sonar or slight colony variation?

voice.instructions: Speak with quiet urgency and clear contrast. Pause briefly before each reveal. Keep the final choice playful and direct.

scenes.headline: BLIND, BUT COLONIES CAN DIFFER
scenes.narration: Zubat is blind, but its colonies may sound different.
scenes.caption: SLIGHTLY DIFFERENT FREQUENCIES BETWEEN COLONIES

scenes.headline: SOUND REPLACES SIGHT
scenes.narration: It has no eyes, so ultrasonic waves check obstacles in darkness.
scenes.caption: ULTRASONIC WAVES CHECK THE WAY

scenes.headline: ZUBAT READS REFLECTIONS
scenes.narration: It emits waves from its mouth, then reads their reflections.
scenes.caption: EMIT. REFLECT. CHECK.

scenes.headline: FREQUENCIES CAN DIFFER
scenes.narration: Then comes the strange part: frequencies can differ slightly between colonies.
scenes.caption: SLIGHT DIFFERENCES BETWEEN COLONIES

scenes.headline: DIFFERENT DOESN'T MEAN OPPOSITE
scenes.narration: The variation is slight, but the waves still check surroundings.
scenes.caption: SLIGHT VARIATION. SAME SONAR JOB.

scenes.headline: SAME TOOL. DIFFERENT FREQUENCY.
scenes.narration: Which is cooler: eyeless sonar or colony variation?
scenes.caption: SAME SONAR, SLIGHTLY DIFFERENT FREQUENCIES
